simple.meaning: to fold , i.e. duplicate (literally or figuratively); by implication, to transmute (transitive or intransitive)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to שָׁנָה (H8138) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 22 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: שָׁנָה (shânâh) means to fold , i.e. duplicate (literally or figuratively); by implication, to transmute (transitive or intransitive) First listed occurrence: 1Kgs 14 2.
